summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a pinned Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and immediately invokes it to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) obfuscated with a shuffled-string-array plus numeric-dictionary scheme (hex-named identifiers, string-array rotator, ~1000-entry constant dictionary). Neither the file nor a Bun dependency is referenced in the package's README, bin entries, or CHANGELOG for this version — the advertised purpose is Ornikar's shared prettier/commitlint/husky/lint-staged configuration. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern (fetching a non-Node runtime at preinstall solely to execute a bundled obfuscated payload) hands attacker-controlled bytes execution on the installer's machine on `npm install`, bypassing Node-based tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
